phase: Phase 1 — LSL infra user-side install guide

step_1_labrecorder_mac.purpose: GUI for recording multiple synchronized LSL streams to a single .xdf file
install_steps: 3. First launch: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> 'Open Anyway' (Apple Gatekeeper)
4. Grant network access on the Local Network prompt (LSL uses multicast UDP on 224.0.0.183 port 16571)
step_1_labrecorder_mac.verification: App launches, shows 'Update' button — pressing it should NOT yet show streams (none broadcasting)

step_2_pylsl_install.purpose: Python LSL client lib for outlet/inlet test + .xdf load in analysis
step_2_pylsl_install.verify_command: python3 -c "import pylsl, pyxdf; print('pylsl', pylsl.__version__, 'pyxdf', pyxdf.__version__)"
step_2_pylsl_install.common_failure_macos_arm64: if 'no liblsl found': brew install labstreaminglayer/tap/lsl
step_2_pylsl_install.common_failure_ubuntu: sudo apt-get install -y liblsl (or build from source if not in apt)

step_3_outlet_inlet_smoke_test.purpose: Confirm LSL can broadcast and receive on the same machine before going cross-host
step_3_outlet_inlet_smoke_test.outlet_one_liner_mac: python3 -c "from pylsl import StreamInfo, StreamOutlet, local_clock; import time; info = StreamInfo('anima_smoke_test', 'TestStream', 1, 1.0, 'float32', 'smoke_uid_001'); outlet = StreamOutlet(info); print('outlet up'); [outlet.push_sample([float(i)]) or time.sleep(1) for i in range(60)]"
step_3_outlet_inlet_smoke_test.inlet_one_liner_mac_separate_terminal: python3 -c "from pylsl import StreamInlet, resolve_byprop; print('searching...'); streams = resolve_byprop('name', 'anima_smoke_test', timeout=10); inlet = StreamInlet(streams[0]); [print(inlet.pull_sample(timeout=2.0)) for _ in range(10)]"
step_3_outlet_inlet_smoke_test.expected_inlet_output: 10 lines of ([0.0], ts), ([1.0], ts), ... matching outlet stream
if_inlet_finds_no_stream: Check macOS firewall: System Settings -> Network -> Firewall -> allow python3
Confirm both terminals are on same Wi-Fi/LAN if cross-host
lsl_api.cfg: add 'KnownPeers = {ubu1.local}' to ~/lsl_api/lsl_api.cfg if multicast blocked

step_4_cross_host_mac_to_ubu1.purpose: Verify ubu1-published CLM stream can be discovered from user mac
step_4_cross_host_mac_to_ubu1.ubu1_outlet_test: ssh ubu1 'python3 -c "from pylsl import StreamInfo, StreamOutlet; import time; info = StreamInfo(\"ubu1_smoke\", \"Test\", 1, 1.0, \"float32\", \"ubu1_uid\"); o = StreamOutlet(info); [o.push_sample([1.0]) or time.sleep(1) for _ in range(120)]"'
step_4_cross_host_mac_to_ubu1.mac_inlet_discover: python3 -c "from pylsl import resolve_byprop; print(resolve_byprop('name', 'ubu1_smoke', timeout=10))"
step_4_cross_host_mac_to_ubu1.expected: non-empty list of StreamInfo; if empty -> mac and ubu1 are not on the same multicast domain (Wi-Fi isolation, Tailscale subnet routing, etc.)
step_4_cross_host_mac_to_ubu1.tailscale_or_ssh_tunnel_fallback: Tailscale typically passes LSL multicast OK; if not, run an ssh -R tunnel of UDP 16571 (lsl-relay-app exists for this exact purpose)

step_5_user_one_line_verifier.purpose: After all 3 streams (anima_clm_tension, anima_tension_link_5ch, anima_phase_marker) are published, confirm LabRecorder sees them
step_5_user_one_line_verifier.command: python3 -c "from pylsl import resolve_streams; [print(s.name(), s.type(), s.channel_count(), s.nominal_srate(), 'Hz') for s in resolve_streams(wait_time=5.0)]"

honest_notes: LabRecorder does NOT need pylsl to record — but pylsl is needed to PUBLISH the CLM streams from ubu1
macOS Sequoia (15.x) and later: Local Network permission popup is mandatory; deny = no LSL discovery
OpenBCI side: GUI v6.x has a built-in LSL outlet plugin (Networking widget -> LSL); enable it before recording
